### The Great Multitude
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-great-multitude
Passage: Revelation 7:9-12
Points:
- The innumerable multitude from every tongue and tribe proves that God's people are defined by faith rather than ethnic descent.
- Because God welcomes believers from all ethnicities, any form of racism directly opposes the body of Christ.
- The sheer size of this heavenly host assures believers that the gospel will never fail to save God's people.
- The gospel does not rely on worldly status or cultural dominance to fulfill God's redemptive purposes.

### Bible Pathways 12/25/2001
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-12-or-25-or-2001-1127344.html
Passage: Revelation 7:9-12
Points:
- While believers often feel like an embattled minority on earth, heaven reveals an uncountably vast multitude of overcomers.
- The vision offered direct encouragement to early Christians undergoing intense imperial persecution.
- The praise directed to God honors His supreme wisdom, authority, and saving love.
- Earthly suffering and opposition fade in significance before the promise of eternal life in the presence of the Lamb.
- Christ Himself will satisfy every longing and wipe away every tear from His people's eyes.
